title: an annotation runs after every annotation it names in needs
manifest_yaml:
agent_control_specification_version: 0.5.0-alpha.1
policies:
  p:
    type: rego
    query: data.acs.verdict
intervention_points:
  input:
    policy:
      id: p
    policy_target: $snap.input
    annotations:
      gamma:
        needs: [beta]
        from: $pi.annotations.beta.value
      alpha:
        from: $target.text
      beta:
        needs: [alpha]
        from: $pi.annotations.alpha.value
annotators:
  alpha:
    type: classifier
  beta:
    type: classifier
  gamma:
    type: classifier
